work_unit.title: 增加完整工作结果与版本绑定
work_unit.goal: 让 IntegrationTask 和 HumanTask 使用各自不可变、Workspace-scoped、版本固定的结果事实，并禁止 IntegrationTask 伪造成 Agent Run。

codebase_context.current_gap: IntegrationRun has no attempt, graph revision, connection, connector version, commit, criterion, environment, provider receipt, or idempotency binding. HumanWorkResult does not exist. CreateRun still permits integration_run rows in the Agent Run table.
codebase_context.compatibility: Existing IntegrationRun rows remain readable with nullable compatibility fields. New commands require complete bindings and create an immutable first IntegrationAttempt.
codebase_context.ownership: Go Domain API owns result writes. PostgreSQL owns facts; Temporal may only invoke commands in T005.

data_rules: No destructive DROP or invented backfill values.
New IntegrationRun binding columns are nullable only for pre-T004 compatibility rows; validators require them for new commands.
IntegrationAttempt and HumanWorkResult are append-only and use composite Workspace foreign keys wherever the parent schema supports them.
Provider receipts and result payloads must not contain credentials.

amendments.reason: Pre-RED inventory resolved the actual shared validator and read-model test paths and added the create-Run validator needed to prove IntegrationTask cannot be represented as an Agent Run.
The new public compatibility route must remain represented in the generated OpenAPI contract.

tdd_plan.red: Add schema, validator, and PostgreSQL integration tests for complete bindings, wrong node kinds, cross-Workspace references, idempotent replay, immutable attempts/results, and rejection of integration_run through CreateRun.
tdd_plan.green: Add the minimum expand migration, Go commands/store handlers, shared contracts, and read-model mapping.
tdd_plan.refactor: Centralize WorkNode binding checks and preserve compatibility projection for old IntegrationRun rows.

checks: Agent Run, IntegrationRun, and HumanWorkResult cannot substitute for one another
new result facts bind the active TargetRevision and GraphRevision
IntegrationAttempt binds connection, connector version, provider reference, idempotency key, and receipt
HumanWorkResult binds authenticated human, input version, immutable result hash, and optional artifact or attachment hash
legacy rows remain readable without fabricated bindings

stop_conditions: A required parent cannot be Workspace-scoped without a destructive migration.
Compatibility would require inventing version, connection, commit, environment, criterion, or receipt values.
The change would make Temporal or the UI a direct fact writer.
